verses.en: And all the people gathered themselves together as one man into the street that was before the water gate; and they spake unto Ezra the scribe to bring the book of the law of Moses, which the LORD had commanded to Israel.
verses.sm: Ua faapotopoto mai le nuu uma e pei o se tagata e toatasi i le malae o i luma o le faitotoa o le vai; ona latou fai atu lea ia Esera le tusiupu e au mai le tusi o le tulafono a Mose, na poloai mai ai le ALII ia Isaraelu.

verses.en: And Ezra the priest brought the law before the congregation both of men and women, and all that could hear with understanding, upon the first day of the seventh month.
verses.sm: Ona au mai ai lea e Esera le faitaulaga le tulafono i luma o le faapotopotoga o tane atoa ma fafine, ma i latou uma O e atamamai i faalogo, i le aso muamua i le masina e fitu.

verses.en: And he read therein before the street that was before the water gate from the morning until midday, before the men and the women, and those that could understand; and the ears of all the people were attentive unto the book of the law.
verses.sm: Ona ia faitau ai lea i le malae o i luma o le faitotoa o le vai, e afua i le malama ae o le taeao ua oo i le aoauli, i luma o tane ma fafine, ma e atamamai; ua uai mai foi taliga o le nuu uma i le tusi o le tulafono.

verses.en: And Ezra the scribe stood upon a pulpit of wood, which they had made for the purpose; and beside him stood Mattithiah, and Shema, and Anaiah, and Urijah, and Hilkiah, and Maaseiah, on his right hand; and on his left hand, Pedaiah, and Mishael, and Malchiah, and Hashum, and Hashbadana, Zechariah, and Meshullam.
verses.sm: Ua tu foi Esera le tusiupu i luga i le tulaga laau, na latou fausia i lea lava mea; ua tutū faatasi foi ma ia i lona itu taumatau o Matatia, ma Sema, ma Anaia, ma Uria, ma Hilikia, ma Maaseia; a o i lona itu tauagavale, o Petaia, ma Mesaelu, ma Malekia, ma Hasumu, ma Hasepaiana, o Sakaria ma Mesulama.

verses.en: And Ezra opened the book in the sight of all the people; (for he was above all the people;) and when he opened it, all the people stood up:
verses.sm: Ona fofola lea e Esera le tusi i luma o le nuu uma; (aua sa maualuga ia i le nuu uma;) ua ia fofola ai, ona tutù lea i luga o le nuu uma.

verses.en: And Ezra blessed the LORD, the great God. And all the people answered, Amen, Amen, with lifting up their hands: and they bowed their heads, and worshipped the LORD with their faces to the ground.
verses.sm: Ona faafetai atu lea o Esera i le ALI le Atua silisili; ona tali mai lea o le nuu uma, Amene, Amene, ua sisii i luga o latou lima; ma ua latou punonou ma ifo toele i le ALII.

verses.en: Also Jeshua, and Bani, and Sherebiah, Jamin, Akkub, Shabbethai, Hodijah, Maaseiah, Kelita, Azariah, Jozabad, Hanan, Pelaiah, and the Levites, caused the people to understand the law: and the people stood in their place.
verses.sm: O Iosua foi, ma Pani, ma Serepeia, o Iaminu, o Akupa, o Sapetai, o Hotia, o Maaseia, o Kelita, o Asaria, o Iosapata, o Hanana, o Pelaia, ma sa Levi, ua latou faamatalaina atu le tulafono i le nuu, o loo tutù mai foi le nuu.

verses.en: So they read in the book in the law of God distinctly, and gave the sense, and caused them to understand the reading.
verses.sm: Ua latou faitau mae'a i le tusi i le tulafono a le Atua, ma ua latou folafola atu le uiga, ma faamatalaina atu 12 te i latou le mea ua faitauina.

verses.en: And Nehemiah, which is the Tirshatha, and Ezra the priest the scribe, and the Levites that taught the people, said unto all the people, This day is holy unto the LORD your God; mourn not, nor weep. For all the people wept, when they heard the words of the law.
verses.sm: O Neemia, o le alii e pule lea, ma Esera le faitaulaga, le tusiupu, ma sa Levi o e na aʻoaʻo i le nuu, ua latou fai atu i le nuu uma, O le aso paia lenei i le An lo outou Atua, aua neʻi outou faanoanoa, aua foi le fetagisi. Aua ua fetagisi le nuu uma, ina ua latou faalogologo i upu o le tulafono.

verses.en: Then he said unto them, Go your way, eat the fat, and drink the sweet, and send portions unto them for whom nothing is prepared: for this day is holy unto our Lord: neither be ye sorry; for the joy of the LORD is your strength.
verses.sm: Ua ia fai atu foi ia te i latou, Ina o ia outou, ina aai mea lololo, ma inu mea suamalie, ma ia outou ave tufaaga ia te i latou e lei saunia se mea ma latou; aua o le aso paia lenei i lo tatou AW; aua neʻi tiga foi outou; auā o le fiafia i le ALII o lo outou malosi lea.

verses.en: So the Levites stilled all the people, saying, Hold your peace, for the day is holy; neither be ye grieved.
verses.sm: Ua faafilemu atu foi e sa Levi i le nuu uma, ua faapea atu, Fifilemu ia outou; aua o le aso paia lenei, aua neʻi tiga foi outou.

verses.en: And all the people went their way to eat, and to drink, and to send portions, and to make great mirth, because they had understood the words that were declared unto them.
verses.sm: Ona o atu lea o le nuu uma e aai, ma inu, ma ave tufaaga, ma taufaiolioli tele, aua ua latou lagona upu na faailoa atu ia te i latou.

verses.en: And on the second day were gathered together the chief of the fathers of all the people, the priests, and the Levites, unto Ezra the scribe, even to understand the words of the law.
verses.sm: O le aso lua foi na faapotopotoina ai o matai sili o le nuu uma, o faitaulaga, ma sa Levi, ia Esera le tusiupu, ia aʻoaʻoina ai i latou i upu o le tulafono.

verses.en: And they found written in the law which the LORD had commanded by Moses, that the children of Israel should dwell in booths in the feast of the seventh month:
verses.sm: Ona latou iloa lea ua tusia i le tulafono na poloai mai ai le ALI! ia Mose, ia nonofo le fanauga a Isaraelu i fale apitaga i le tausamiga i le masina e fitu;

verses.en: And that they should publish and proclaim in all their cities, and in Jerusalem, saying, Go forth unto the mount, and fetch olive branches, and pine branches, and myrtle branches, and palm branches, and branches of thick trees, to make booths, as it is written.
verses.sm: ma ia latou logologoa‘i atu ma tala‘i atu i a latou aai uma, ma Ierusalema, e faapea atu, Ina o atu ia i le mauga, ma au mai la o le olive, ma la o le laau o le olive vao, ma la o le atasi, ma lau pama, ma la o laau lauolaola, e fai a‘i fale apitaga e pei Ona tusia.

verses.en: So the people went forth, and brought them, and made themselves booths, every one upon the roof of his house, and in their courts, and in the courts of the house of God, and in the street of the water gate, and in the street of the gate of Ephraim.
verses.sm: Ona o atu lea o le nuu, ma ua latou aumaia, ma fai mo latou o fale apitaga, taitoatasi i luga o lona fale, i o latou lotoā foi, ma lotoā o le fale o le Atua, ma le malae o le faitotoa o le vai, ma le malae o le faitotoa o Efaraima.

verses.en: And all the congregation of them that were come again out of the captivity made booths, and sat under the booths: for since the days of Jeshua the son of Nun unto that day had not the children of Israel done so. And there was very great gladness.
verses.sm: O le faapotopotoga urha foi o e na o mai mai le tafeaga, ua latou faia fale apitaga, ma ua latou nonofo i fale apitaga; aua talu ona po o losua le atalii o Nuno ua oo i lea aso, e lei faapea ona fai e le fanauga a Isaraelu. Sa matuá tele lava le fiafia.

verses.en: Also day by day, from the first day unto the last day, he read in the book of the law of God. And they kept the feast seven days; and on the eighth day was a solemn assembly, according unto the manner.
verses.sm: Ua ia faitau foi i le tusi o le tulafono a le Atua i lea aso ma lea aso, e afua i le aso muamua ua oo i le aso e iu ai. O aso e fitu foi ua latou fai ai le tausamiga, ua faia foi le faapotopotoga i le aso e valu, e tusa ma le tu.
